item.title: Former Ador CEO referred to prosecutors over NewJeans' attempted contract termination
item.description:
Korea Herald • Contract / agency
Seoul Mapo Police Station referred Min Hee-jin, former CEO of K-pop agency Ador and current head of Ooak Records, to prosecutors Monday on suspicion of breach of trust over her alleged involvement in NewJeans' attempt to terminate its exclusive contracts with the agency in 2024. Min denied the allegations and questioned how details of the police investigation had reached the media before she was formally notified of the decision. item.title: Exo’s Kai, Sehun finalize duo debut plan
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
Kai and Sehun of Exo have set a date to release their first EP as a subunit: Dec. 1. The mini album will be titled “Waking Up the City,” and will consist of seven tracks, including the lead single of the same title, as well as solo music from the two, according to label SM Entertainment on Wednesday.
